tldr: An open BOF with the LangChain4j community on the project's current state, adoption stories, challenges and roadmap.
summary: The session is an interactive discussion with members of the LangChain4j community, hosted by Dimitris Andreadis. LangChain4j debuted at Devoxx Belgium 2023 and has become a key framework for integrating LLMs into Java applications.

Participants discuss the project's current state, real-world adoption stories, ongoing challenges and roadmap developments, and are invited to ask questions, give feedback and exchange ideas, whether they use it in production or are just starting.
keyPoints: Discussion of the current state and future direction of LangChain4j.
Real-world adoption stories and ongoing challenges.
Open Q&A and feedback from users and contributors.
takeaways: Bring feedback or feature requests for LangChain4j to the maintainers.
watchIf: You use or are considering LangChain4j and want to talk with its community.
